flashcards.back: Define village governance, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define local bodies, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define roles and responsibilities, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore village governance
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on village governance. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where local bodies is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach participation to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
